action: Preserve v1r14 unchanged; move cross-field episode-count consistency enforcement to the existing deterministic preregistration execution-contract gate; retain positive-value schema validation; launch fresh v1r15 from the original frozen scientific inputs.
diagnosis: Cross-field executable-contract consistency was enforced prematurely in PreregistrationExecutionContract schema. This bypassed the bounded autonomous repair loop specifically implemented to diagnose and repair execution-contract mismatches.
observed_failure: Autonomous provisional preregistration repeatedly produced an execution_contract whose planned_episode_count was inconsistent with task_count and condition count. Pydantic rejected the object inside run_agent before the deterministic preregistration compatibility/repair gate could receive and repair it.
